_comment: 2026-08-06 (Claude): thumbnail subsystem extracted to headend/api/thumbnails_api.py + headend/media_paths.py, tightened baseline 18661->18650, routes 235->240. Same day, hierarchy hardening (Customer/Site/Camera/Device review requested by Peter) plus GDPR delete/export functionality was added in-place, pushing lines 18650->19100 and routes 240->245 across several rounds. Peter then reminded me (correctly) that this baseline exists to force extraction into domain modules as functionality grows, not to be repeatedly raised as a substitute for it — see his message in the session transcript. Retracted: camera-location lifecycle (retire/move-captures/force-delete/gdpr-delete-captures/assignment-history/device-camera-location) and cold-backup export (list-volumes/export-captures) extracted to headend/api/camera_locations_api.py + headend/api/export_api.py, following the exact pattern of the thumbnails extraction (local _require_role()/_ensure_*_access() re-implementations that lazily import from `main` at request time, since main.py includes these routers near the end of its own module body). Net effect: lines 19100->18667, tightened to 18700 (small margin). Routes moved from @app. to @router. decorators no longer count toward max_direct_routes at all (the ratchet only regexes for @app./@_legacy_app. — see test_architecture_ratchet.py), so the true count dropped 245->232; tightened to 235. Same day, in-browser SSH terminal (Peter — a clickable terminal alongside the existing copy-command option in Admin -> SSH Tunnels, mirroring the edge's own xterm.js break-glass terminal) added as its own new module from the start, headend/api/ssh_tunnel_terminal_api.py — main.py only grew by the two import/include_router lines, 18700->18710 (@router.websocket() is also outside the max_direct_routes regex). 2026-08-07: is_placeholder field added to list_devices() plus camera_id support briefly added in-place to captures_timeline() pushed lines 18710->18726; extracted captures_timeline() itself to headend/api/captures_timeline_api.py (same lazy-import-from-main pattern as the other extractions) since it was already a clean, self-contained ~85-line endpoint, netting lines down to 18646 — tightened to 18660 (small margin). See Dokumentation/HANDOVER_LOG.md for the full accounting.
